scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f)); fs.cpSync('assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true}); console.log('Static build ready in dist');"
